Subject: Co-create: Integration Atelier — joint lab + sponsored track at DevSummit NA

Hi Lena —

Great meeting last week. HelixOps' connector to our runtime feels like a natural fit for a co-branded technical event at DevSummit NA (Sept). Instead of a standard webinar, we'd like to propose an "Integration Atelier": a half-day session that blends a short product roadmap panel, a 30-minute hands-on lab where attendees follow a guided integration tutorial, and a short customer/partner showcase.

High-level ask from our side:
- Redwood provides 2 engineers for the lab and a 20-min product roadmap slot
- HelixOps provides an integration lead and 1 customer for a brief case study
- Joint promotion (email + blog swap + shared social posts)
- Sponsorship commitment to secure a breakout room and partner booth (we can help with a shared sponsorship)

I've attached a one-pager with a proposed run-of-show and audience targets. Can HelixOps confirm interest and approximate sponsorship contribution range? If yes, Ben and I can draft a joint promo calendar.

Thanks — excited about this.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0173
